migration_review: All 118 SQL-related migration sources captured and their 314 lexical DDL occurrences enumerated. Registered order and selected compatibility/performance migrations reviewed. No migration execution or final sqlite_schema validation.
coverage_limits: Regex discovery is mechanically exhaustive only within the stated tracked production JS/TS source scope and patterns; computed/dynamic SQL or unrecognized wrappers could be missed.
113 non-SQL persistence importers are inventoried as dependency candidates; all caller/control-flow branches were not semantically audited.
packages/shared/nodeSqliteClient.ts and selected ProviderCommitBatch.ts were reviewed separately, outside apps/server/src candidate count.
No complete proof of foreign-key/constraint/index final schema; migration extraction records history, including obsolete/renamed objects and helper modules.
No benchmark, crash injection, data migration, compatibility or behavioral differential test was run in this read-only research.
No claim of measured speedup from any proposed native data structure.
Large ProjectionStore, scheduling, launcher, legacy importer and cleanup modules received selected operation-family review, not exhaustive every-line audit.
